limitedSupport: Bixiyahan laga yaabo inuusan si buuxda u taageersaneyn. Awoodaha (qalabka, aragtida, codka) si otomaatig ah looma oga - ku dar moodooyinka gacanta oo u habee awoodaha moodo kasta.
mlxExperimental: Taageerada MLX waa tijaabo. Embeddings lama heli karo, badhanka fikirka lama xirin weli, iyo qaar ka mid ah qaab-dhismeedyada cusub ee moodooyinka ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku guuldareystaan inay load garaystaan. Ku soo sheeg arrimaha GitHub si aan mudnaanta u siino.
engineBundled: Matoorka saadaasha waxaa ku dhex dhisan Novera, sidaas darteed wax download ah ama update gaar ah ma jirto. Sheeg noocan markaad soo sheegaysid moodo ku guuldareysatay inay load garayso.
engineOtherVersion: Ma u baahan tahay nooc llama.cpp oo kale? Orod llama-server-gaaga oo ku dar sidii bixiye OpenAI-waafaqsan.
refreshModelsError: Bixiyaha waa inuu leeyahay URL asaasi ah iyo ugu yaraan hal furaha API oo la habeeyey si loo soo qaado moodellada.
refreshModelsSuccess: Waxaa lagu daray {{count}} moodel cusub oo ka socda {{provider}}.
noNewModels: Ma jiraan moodel cusub oo la helay. Dhammaan moodelada la heli karo waa lagu daray.
refreshModelsFailed: Waxaa fashilmay soo qaadista moodelada ka socota {{provider}}. Fadlan hubi furahaaga API iyo URL asaasi ah.
backendHistoryLoading: Waxaa la soo raraya taariikhda cusbooneysiinta...
backendHistoryEmpty: Cilad backend ah lama diiwaan gelin weli.
embeddingModelsDesc: Waxaa loo isticmaalaa RAG iyo raadinta vector. Moodeelka la doortay wuxuu noqdaa kan caadiga ah marka la abuurayo embeddings.
embeddingModelSetDefault: Ka dhig moodeelka embedding-ka caadiga ah
importedTooltip: Waxaa laga soo import gareeyay fayl maxalli ah. Ka saarista Novera ma tirtireyso faylka ku jira disk-ka.
importModelSuccess: Moodeelka {{provider}} si guul leh ayaa loo soo import gareeyay.
importModelError: Ku guuldareystay in moodeelka la soo dejiyo:
noModelFoundDesc: Moodeelada la heli karo ayaa halkan lagu soo bandhigi doonaa. Haddii aadan weli lahayn moodeelo, booqo Hub si aad u soo dejiso.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Moodeelada la heli karo ayaa halkan lagu soo bandhigi doonaa. Isticmaal badhanka dib u cusbooneysiinta ee kor si aad uga soo hesho moodeelo bixiyaha, ama ku dar mid gacanta adigoo isticmaalaya badhanka +.

deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Waa la waayay tirtirka moodelada {{count}}. Eeg console-ka si faahfaahin loo helo.

baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Isticmaal xuddunta booskaaga iyo gobolaga Alibaba Cloud. Beddel YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID aqoonsiga booskaaga oo isticmaal furaha API ee isla gobolka.

apiKeys.title: Furayaasha API
apiKeys.description: Geli furahaaga API. Waxaad ku dari kartaa furayaal dheeraad ah Qalab Kheyraadka, oo Novera isku dayi doontaa midka xiga haddii fure uu guuldarreysto.
apiKeys.testHint: Waxay hubisaa /models furaha kasta waxayna muujisaa xaaladda furaha marka la eego.
